standard_prerequisites.name: Sheaves of f^{-1}O-modules correspond to sheafifications of presheaves of f_pO-modules (lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules)
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the first equality between sheaf and presheaf module Hom sets.

core_obligations: The module structures on f^{-1}G and f_*F are those of the pullback and pushforward module constructions, with f_*F viewed as an O-module via the unit O -> f_*f^{-1}O (statement lines 3162-3166). The first equality identifies Mor_{Mod(f^{-1}O)}(f^{-1}G, F) with Mor_{Mod(f_pO)}(f_pG, F) because sheaves of modules are sheafifications of the corresponding presheaf modules (proof lines 3172-3177, justified at 3176-3177). The second equality is the presheaf-level push-pull adjunction for module presheaves, giving Mor_{Mod(O)}(G, f_*F) (proof lines 3175-3179, justified at 3177-3179). Chaining yields the asserted bijection, bifunctorial in G and F (proof lines 3168-3180).
proof_roadmap: Pass from sheaf modules to presheaf modules via the sheafification equivalence (proof lines 3172-3177).
Apply the presheaf push-pull adjunction and read off the bijection (proof lines 3177-3180).
